env.ours: x3d.threejs reader (shared with the Babylon bridge) + three.js body, bundle sha fa1672fe84a6

gaps: weights: X_ITE 16.6.0 draws a weighted curve with the weights applied wrongly (a quarter circle of radius up to 1.24); this node follows the standard (radius 1 to 1e-5), so a weighted curve is only checked in this engine and X_ITE only records its own measure
line width is one pixel in both engines (the body draws an anti-aliased ribbon of the same width)
the control points are Coordinate or CoordinateDouble; GeoCoordinate is not read as a control point
scope: the point lists are the curve points the two engines build (X_ITE tessellate() through its private getVertices, ours spec.lines), the pictures are the silhouette and colour of the drawn lines (SwiftShader CPU raster); picking of lines is not compared
